gloss: to nurture, to foster, to cultivate

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {育|はぐく}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to nurture, to foster, to cultivate
definitions.explanation: To carefully raise or develop something over time, whether a living thing, a relationship, or an abstract quality like talent or trust.

examples.japanese: ⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{育|はぐく}む。
{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{育|はぐく}むこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to cultivate children's talents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な⟦{感性|かんせい}→感性：12628_kansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{育|はぐく}んでほしい。
examples.english: I want them to develop a rich sensitivity through nature.

notes:
{育|はぐく}む implies careful, sustained nurturing over a long period. It is warmer and more deliberate than ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{育|はぐく}む

ASPECT (ている):
- {育|はぐく}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: is nurturing, has been cultivating

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{育|はぐく}む (to nurture love)
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{育|はぐく}む (to cultivate talent)
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{育|はぐく}む (to build trust)
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{育|はぐく}む (to nurture life)
- ⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{育|はぐく}む (to foster friendship)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise, to bring up (more general, practical)
- {育|はぐく}む: to nurture, to foster (more emotional, literary)
